transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... mostly a situation at work. I'm on leave right now. 

I, uh... I pushed ahead with a new onboarding launch recently. I ended up committing company money and some vendor time before the official approvals were actually in place. At the time, it just... it felt bold. Like it was necessary to get things moving. 

But... yeah. Now I'm on administrative leave, and everyone keeps asking what I was thinking. So... that's why I'm here.
Did you think about the potential consequences of spending company money without approval before you did it?
Not really. Like I said... at the time, it just felt necessary. I didn't think about the fallout. I just wanted to get it done.
Have you often acted on impulse like this in other situations, not just at work?
I don't know. Not really, I guess. I mean... I don't think so. Just the thing at work.
Have you ever acted on impulse in your personal relationships?
I... no. Not really. I mean, I don't think so. My personal life is pretty quiet. Just... normal stuff, I guess. Nothing like what happened at the office.
Have you ever been in trouble with the law?
No. Never. I... I've never been arrested or anything like that. Just... no.
Have you ever lied to someone to get what you wanted?
No. I mean... I work in HR, so... I try to just play by the rules. I don't really do that. Just... no.
Have you ever done something that hurt someone else, even if you didn't mean to?
I... I don't know. I mean, maybe? People get their feelings hurt sometimes, but... I don't think I've done anything major. Just... normal misunderstandings, I suppose. Nothing that stands out.
Have you ever intentionally broken rules or social norms outside of the workplace?
No. I... I don't really go out of my way to do things like that. I just... keep to myself, mostly. I don't break rules.
Have you ever done something that put others at risk of harm?
No. I... I don't think so. I'm pretty careful, usually. I don't really do things like that.
Have you ever talked someone into doing something that they didn't want to do?
No, I don't think so. I'm not really... persuasive like that. I just let people make their own choices.
Did you ever get into trouble at school for behaving badly or breaking rules when you were a kid?
No, not really. I... I did fine in school. I wasn't the type to get sent to the principal or anything like that. I just kept my head down, mostly.
Have you always been someone who makes decisions quickly, without thinking them through?
No, not always. I mean... I usually think things through. I don't just jump into things without looking.
Has your tendency to act on impulse without thinking things through started recently or has it been something you've experienced for a long time?

I don't know if I'd call it an impulse, really. But... I guess things have been a bit different lately. Maybe for about a month or so. It started around the time this new executive came in... he kept pushing back on my redesign for the onboarding process. So... yeah, just the last month.
Do you think your decision to spend company money without approval is part of who you are as a person, or was it just a one-time mistake?

I... I don't think it's who I am. I just... I pushed ahead with the onboarding launch. I committed the company money and the vendor time before the approvals were actually in place. 

At the time, I just... I thought it was bold. I thought it was necessary to get things moving. But... now I'm on administrative leave. And everyone keeps asking me what I was thinking. So... I guess it was a mistake.
Have you noticed any other changes in your behavior over the past month, aside from the incident at work?
Not really. I mean... no. Just the situation at work. I don't think anything else has been different.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt like you were taking more risks than usual?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I'm usually pretty careful with things. It's just... just this recent situation at work. I don't think there's been anything else.
Have you ever felt like you're more impulsive when under stress or pressure?
I... no. Not really. I mean, there's always pressure at work, but... I don't think it makes me do things like that. I usually just deal with it.
Do you think you have a tendency to be reckless or disregard rules in general?
No. I mean... I work in HR. Following rules is basically what I do. So, no, I wouldn't say I'm reckless.
Have you ever had any other instances where you acted impulsively in a way that had significant consequences?
No. Um... not that I can think of. I just... I don't really live my life like that. It's really just been this one thing. I don't know what else to tell you.
Do you think this incident at work is related to a bigger issue with how you approach decisions and rules in your life?
No. I really don't. I... I approach decisions the same way I always have. It's not some bigger issue. It was just an isolated thing.
